external_gates.requirement: Configure the four public Shopify App Pricing plans exactly as recorded here.

Create a Partner API client with Manage apps permission and configure SHOPIFY_PARTNER_API_ACCESS_TOKEN in hosted environments. Organization ID and per-environment App GIDs are already committed runtime configuration.
Complete at least one English App Store listing and all required listing fields/assets.
Configure the Partner account emergency developer contact.
Complete any protected customer data declarations required by the submission form.
Provide reviewer instructions/test-store access needed to exercise billing and core app flows.
Pass Shopify submission automated checks before submitting for review.
Submit the completed app for Shopify review.
After the accepted release, run Final Production Merchant Smoke and record PASS evidence.
